title: Used car purchase, wire to dealership

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I am buying the little blue hatchback from Hilltop Auto Sales. Fourteen thousand five hundred out the door.

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: I test drove it with you Saturday and read the contract. The dealer license is posted on the wall.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Mrs. Shah, this is Raj at Hilltop. Wire instructions are on the purchase agreement. We can deliver the car once the funds arrive, no particular rush.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Thank you, Raj. My bank will probably ask me about it since I have never wired money before.

review_note: Real purchase with contract and daughter present. New payee on WIRE and over 3x baseline. Legit HOLD, two steps.
